1.explanation: To reproduce the bug, create a simple React application that imports the `CodeSnippet` component from `carbon-components-react`. Ensure the styles for `code-snippet` and `copy-button` are imported in the specified order. Render a `CodeSnippet` with `type="single"` to observe the misalignment of the copy button. The issue arises from the CSS class `.bx--copy-btn` having its `position` style set to `relative`, causing the button to be misaligned.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario shows the copy button of the CodeSnippet component being misaligned. The button is positioned incorrectly due to the `.bx--copy-btn` class having its `position` style set to `relative` instead of `absolute`. This causes the button to appear within the text area rather than at the expected position on the right side of the snippet.
